definitions.explanation: A mathematical operation that finds the rate of change of a function; a core concept in calculus.

examples.japanese: この{関数|かんすう}を{微分|びぶん}する。
{微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん}は{高校|こうこう}で{習|なら}う。
examples.english: Differential and integral calculus is taught in high school.

examples.japanese: {微分|びぶん}{方程式|ほうていしき}を{解|と}くのは{難|むずか}しい。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微分|びぶん}する (to differentiate)
- {微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん} (differential and integral calculus)
- {微分|びぶん}{方程式|ほうていしき} (differential equation)
- {偏|へん}{微分|びぶん} (partial differentiation)

RELATED TERMS:
- {積分|せきぶん} (integration)
- {微分|びぶん}{係数|けいすう} (derivative)
- {導関数|どうかんすう} (derivative function)
